content_text:
November 25 ,2025
You can create your life the way art is made.

What’s the main concept of the job again?

I need to think carefully and break these priorities down into concrete action steps.

My two main priorities right now are:  improving my English,  and  exploring and putting into practice a side hustle.

I’ll also think about what else I can do for her moving forward.

Nothing serious, just a small deal.

Following your biological rhythms and have a good rest, which can help you have a better performance.

If someone says something critical I take it to heart.

The economy is just one of several critical problems the country is grappling with.

I don't what your mean.  I can't catch your drift.

Every American technology company claims that their LLMs are state-of-the-art.
